name: Cisco
summary:
Cisco is the networking company at cisco.com. The bridge mark in the tab is what docs and support bookmarks request, taken from the host response.

Checked 12 November 2026 against cisco.com. HTML came from https://www.cisco.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.cisco.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 1406 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 16×16.
